pages.title: Weather Observer
pages.text: A small box that sends a $(l:radiocraft:sky/weather_station)Local Weather Station$()'s readings over the air. Touch it to a radio (or cable it with data wire) within 64 blocks of a station.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Every 5 minutes, and on a redstone pulse, it sends a short burst on its radio's frequency: two pips and a slow warble, not APRS. Its green lamp lights as it goes.$(br2)A $(l:radiocraft:sky/weather_alert_generator)Weather Alert Generator$() with a radio on the same frequency counts it as a station. One callsign does for all your observers: they are told apart by where they are.

pages.title: An outpost
pages.text: Local Weather Station, Weather Observer, a radio and an antenna: that is a weather outpost. Right click the observer to see what it is missing (a callsign, a station, a radio switched on) or when it last sent.
